description: This file defines the 'Update' class for constructing and executing SQL UPDATE queries within Drupal's database abstraction layer. It includes methods for setting fields, expressions, executing the query, and converting the query to a string.

classes.name: Update
classes.description: Represents an SQL UPDATE query with methods to set fields, expressions, execute the query, and generate the SQL string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Update query with a database connection, target table, and options.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Sets the fields and their values to be updated.

methods.name: expression
methods.description: Specifies a field to be updated with an expression, taking precedence over simple field-value pairs.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the constructed UPDATE query and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the query object into a SQL UPDATE statement string.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the combined arguments for the query, including condition arguments.

methods.name: getQueryArguments
methods.description: Prepares and returns the query arguments and update values with placeholders.
